en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a crowded river ferry in the foreground carrying many people across a wide river. On the opposite bank there is a sloping shore with paths, small wooden structures and a long pavilion-like building with a distinctive roof and spire, backed by dense forest on a hill. There is red-printed caption text at the bottom and extensive handwritten message text in dark ink along the right side and bottom.
